'''False light side aura''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] conjured through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], that covered a [[darksider]]'s dark side aura with one of [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]]. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]] used this to infiltrate the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Using this spell she fooled even [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] into thinking she was a follower of the light.
